items.name: Bristol Open 2020
items.information: # The competition is cancelled due to COVID-19. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **It is not permitted to bring food or drink into the venue.** Please consume any food or drink you bring with you, or purchase during break periods, outside of the venue only. Alternatively, feel free to avail yourself of the on-site food and drink offerings. [![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/OXOffhf.png)](https://ukca.squarespace.com/)

items.name: North Carolina Championship 2020

venue.name: NC State Fairgrounds
venue.address: 1025 Blue Ridge Rd, Raleigh, North Carolina 27607

items.information: # The competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. This competition is the State Championship for North Carolina, USA. Winners in each event from North Carolina will receive an award and the title of North Carolina State Champion. Every competitor **must** read the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorthCarolinaChampionship2020#14226-competitor-information) Tab prior to registering. To help limit crowding we ask that competitors only bring one (and at most two) guests with them to the competition. Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us. Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made via the email address you provided when you set up your WCA account. Registrations have to be approved *manually.* Please allow up to 48 hrs for your name to appear on the competitor's list. **If you are competing in Multi-Blind you must submit your cubes at 4:40pm on Saturday.**

items.name: Welcome Back Jönköping 2020

venue.name: [Kulturhuset](https://kulturhusetjonkoping.se/)
venue.details: The competition is in the attic, up the stairs to your left

items.information: Välkomna tillbaka! För första gången sedan i mars är det nu möjligt att arrangera en tävling igen. Denna tävling kommer att genomföras med en rad restriktioner för att förbygga smittorisken, läs mer om detta på de övriga flikarna. --- Welcome back! For the first time since March, we are now able to organize a competition once again. This competition will be subject to several restrictions to prevent the risk of infection, please read more about this in the other tabs.
